title: Manager
description:
Job Description Manager FIT& GIT (India & SAARC Countries) Job Location: Ernakulam Job Summary The Manager – FIT & GIT India & SAARC Countries will be responsible for leading and managing the sales and operations of FIT and GIT holiday products across India and SAARC destinations. The role will focus on achieving revenue and profitability targets, developing competitive tour packages, managing key customer relationships, leading the team, and ensuring seamless service delivery. The position requires strong knowledge of Indian and SAARC destinations, excellent sales and negotiation skills, and the ability to manage both individual and group travel requirements. Key Responsibilities Sales & Revenue Management Develop and execute sales strategies for FIT and GIT products covering Indian and SAARC destinations. Achieve assigned monthly, quarterly, and annual sales and revenue targets. Monitor team performance against sales targets, conversion ratios, average booking value, and profitability. Drive new customer acquisition and strengthen existing customer relationships. Handle and support high-value, group, and key customer accounts. Identify new business opportunities through direct sales, travel partners, and other channels. Review quotations and ensure competitive pricing while maintaining required margins. Monitor receivables and coordinate with the Finance team for timely collections. FIT & GIT Tour Management Oversee the planning and execution of customized FIT itineraries and GIT packages. Develop attractive and commercially viable holiday packages for Indian and SAARC destinations. Ensure proper coordination of hotels, transportation, sightseeing, activities, guides, permits, and other travel services. Handle complex group requirements, special requests, and customized itineraries. Ensure accurate costing, pricing, inclusions, exclusions, cancellation policies, and other package details. Review and approve quotations and itineraries within the company's pricing and approval guidelines. Team Management Lead, guide, and monitor the FIT & GIT sales team. Allocate leads and enquiries among team members based on workload and business priorities. Set individual and team targets and conduct regular performance reviews. Coach team members on sales techniques, destination knowledge, negotiation, and customer handling. Monitor follow-ups and ensure timely closure of leads and enquiries. Identify performance gaps and implement corrective and improvement measures. Maintain discipline, accountability, and productivity within the team. Customer Relationship Management Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, corporate clients, travel agents, and business partners. Handle escalated customer complaints and ensure timely resolution. Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction throughout the sales and travel journey. Qualifications & Experience Graduate in any discipline; a qualification in Travel & Tourism or a related field will be an added advantage. Minimum 7–10 years of experience in holiday sales/travel operations, with relevant experience in FIT and GIT handling. Prior experience in a supervisory or managerial role is preferred. Strong experience in Indian and SAARC destination products. Proven track record of achieving sales and revenue targets. Experience in handling group tours, customized itineraries, and high-value bookings. Required Skills Strong leadership and team management skills. Excellent sales, negotiation, and closing skills. Strong knowledge of Indian and SAARC destinations. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Strong customer relationship management skills. Good commercial and financial understanding, including costing and margins. Ability to develop and price customized FIT and GIT packages. Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities. Ability to work effectively in a target-driven and fast-paced environment. Proficiency in CRM systems and Microsoft Office applications. Strong coordination skills with suppliers and internal departments. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Achievement of monthly and annual revenue targets. Gross profit and margin achievement. Repeat business and customer retention. Team productivity and target achievement. Supplier and service quality management. Timely and accurate CRM and sales reporting.

Key Skills: Holiday Packages,Domestic,Tourism,Travel Sales,Leisure,Outbound Tours,Itinerary,Travel Agency
